description: ERR-PARTIAL: INSERT INTO T ... SELECT FROM S ORDER BY K with dbFailOnError, for groups whose key collision is first (G=1), middle (G=2) and last (G=3); then G=2 again without dbFailOnError; then UPDATE T SET ID = ID + 1 with dbFailOnError. After each: Errors, RecordsAffected and T's rows ordered by ID. After Close, a read-only reopen reads T's rows independently.
